verification.word_id_source: November 2025 HSK 3.0 examination syllabus, cumulative official IDs 2001–3600 (numbered homograph headwords preserved).
verification.gloss_source: Brief English gloss candidates cross-referenced against drkameleon/complete-hsk-vocabulary MIT-licensed CC-CEDICT-derived newest HSK5; selected senses and 190 glossary overrides are editorial drafts, not individually verified.
verification.sentence_policy: 3,200 distinct draft examples: some manually rewritten from scratch; remaining examples are transparent, algorithmically drafted contextual sentences requiring linguistic review before learning use.
verification.pinyin_policy: Headword readings preserve November 2025 syllabus. Sentence readings composed from longest-known cumulative HSK 1–5 word segments, with ICU fallback for unknown characters; word segmentation, third-tone sandhi and polyphony are not native-speaker certified.
verification.vocabulary_boundary_policy: Target cumulative HSK 1–5 IDs 1–3600; example vocabulary boundary and word-level segmentation are not independently certified.
verification.taxonomy_policy: Unchanged hsk3_topics.json v2.0.0, exactly 22 parent topics and 25 existing subtopics. Reclassification of Level 5 only; Levels 1–4 untouched.
verification.review_limitations: Structural checks only. Exact sense, POS, idiomaticity, reading in context, translation quality and natural spoken/written distinctions are still editorially unverified.
